rules.name: shared-is-a-leaf
rules.comment: src/shared/ is a leaf: it imports nothing in the package outside src/shared/ (packages and Node built-ins are fine), so every folder can use it without a cycle.

rules.name: platform-not-to-modules
rules.comment: src/platform/ holds cross-cutting concerns that feature modules build on; a platform file never imports a module. src/platform/registry/ is the composition root (DI and route tables): it wires every module and is exempt.

rules.name: controller-not-to-persistence
rules.comment: A controller handles requests and delegates to services; it never imports persistence directly: schema, table and entity definitions, migrations, or a data-access file (*.repository, *.repo, *.dao). 19 data-access files that reach no database today are adapters and exempt: src/maintenance/maintenance-health.repository.ts, src/modules/auth/oauth.repository.ts, src/modules/job/job.repository.ts, src/modules/machine-learning/machine-learning.repository.ts, src/modules/maintenance/app.repository.ts, src/modules/maintenance/maintenance-websocket.repository.ts, src/modules/notification/email.repository.ts, src/modules/server/server-info.repository.ts, src/platform/cron/cron.repository.ts, src/platform/crypto/crypto.repository.ts, src/platform/event/event.repository.ts, src/platform/logging/logging.repository.ts, src/platform/media/media.repository.ts, src/platform/metadata/metadata.repository.ts, src/platform/process/process.repository.ts, src/platform/storage/storage.repository.ts, src/platform/telemetry/telemetry.repository.ts, src/platform/websocket/websocket.repository.ts, src/repositories/config.repository.ts.

rules.name: no-cycle-leaving-a-folder
rules.comment: A file-level import cycle may stay inside its folder (a module, a platform concern, shared/); a cycle that leaves the folder fails.
